findings.why: The Bath cell for unit 1 reads '4 and 2(.5)', meaning 4 full and 2 half baths, which is 5 with half = .5. It is not 2 and not blank. The printed text is not a single number, so I've marked this unsure.

Both numbers are printed for unit 1: Total Unit Square Footage is 4,889 and Habitable Square Footage is 3,526 (4,889 minus 1,363 sq ft of cellar). I chose the total-unit column, but the field could mean either one.

read_problems: Unit 1 bath column prints "4 and 2(.5)"; combined beds/baths unclear — transcribed as printed since rule requires exact copy and does not define how to combine mixed entries.

ext_sf (terrace/yard/storage) not separately broken out per unit in a single square-foot column usable per the ext_sf definition; Limited Common Element square footage column (Yard/Storage/Storage & Terrace) exists but combines multiple element types, so left as -.
